outline: This course is to build up the financial framework for students when making financial decisions. The focus is on setting out the basic principles of financial management and applying them to the main decisions faced by the financial managers. It helps students to understand various tools of financial management and use them effectively when making investment and financing decisions.
schedule:
1 Introduction
2 Goals and Governance of the Corporation
3 Agency Problem
4 Financial Markets and Institutions
5 Time Value of Money
6 Level Cash Flows: Perpetuities and Annuities
7 Inflation and Time Value of Money
8 Valuing Bonds
9 Midterm Review and Course Feedback
10 Bond Rates of Return
11 Corporate Bonds and Risk of Default
12 Valuing Stocks
13 Dividend Discount Model
14 Net Present Value Rule
15 IRR Rule
16 Other Investment Criteria

category: 參與課程相關作業、作品、實驗、田野調查(Participation in course-related assignments, works, experiments, or field research)
flexible_learning.content:
Week 17 – Coursework Review and Individual Consultation
Students review key course concepts, previous quizzes, and group reports. Individual consultation is available for students who would like to discuss questions or areas that require further clarification.

Week 18 – Course Reflection and Learning Feedback
Students reflect on their overall learning experience and complete a course reflection and learning feedback questionnaire.
flexible_learning.outcome: Students complete and submit the course reflection and learning feedback questionnaire. Assessment is based on completion and the relevance of their responses to the course content.

assessment:
In-Class Quiz（隨堂測驗）：35%
Group Assignment（分組作業）：35%
Attendance and Class Participation（出席率與課程參與度）：25%
Flexible Learning Outcomes（彈性學習成果）：5%
